name.description: Category heading, e.g. "Greedy Angels & Rare Aged"

sectionGroup.description: Groups this category under a top-level heading on the page, e.g. "Amrut Archive" or "Amrut Bar". Leave blank for no grouping.

description.description: Optional short blurb shown under the category heading

priceColumns.description: Column headers for pricing, separated by commas — e.g. "0.5 oz, 1 oz, 2 oz". Leave blank if items only have one price.

order.description: Sets the display order of this category — lower numbers show first
